lines.zh: 我的毛上补丁一块压一块
lines.en: My wool is a stack of patches.

lines.zh: 我走过草地，毛晃得很沉
lines.en: I cross the grass, my wool heavy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到草厚的地方
lines.en: I shuffle toward thicker grass.

lines.zh: 我的步子和别的羊不太一样
lines.en: My gait is not quite like other sheep.

lines.zh: 我身上每一块颜色都不同
lines.en: Every patch on me is a different colour.
My hooves rustle through dry grass.
I head for the fence line.
I stop for a couple of mouthfuls.
I turn, and the patches turn with me.
I follow the ridge of the field.
My wool is a little coarse.
I walk into the tree shade.

lines.zh: 我身上的补丁被风吹得动
lines.en: The wind stirs the patches on my back.
I keep one steady pace.
I step around the ditch.
I lift my head to the slope ahead.
I stand and chew my cud, slowly.
My wool blocks the wind.
I chew, mouthful by mouthful.

lines.zh: 补丁在阳光下颜色不一
lines.en: The patches look different colours in the sun.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一床被子
lines.en: I hold still like a quilt.
A fly lands on my back.
I shake my head to shoo it.

lines.zh: 这草地没什么好担心的
lines.en: Nothing to worry about in this meadow.
My eyes are half closed.
I listen to a distant bell.
A bell is ringing in the distance.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹成一个方向
lines.en: The wind lays my wool all one way.
Standing is resting, for me.
Grass here, so this is a good place.
I sneeze.
I roll my neck slowly.
You are staring at my wool.

lines.zh: 这些补丁都是我自己的
lines.en: These patches are all mine.
I lift my head to look at you.
Do you have shears?
I turn a little so you can see.
I do not like being petted too long.
Your colours are not like mine.
I've never seen your color before.
If you shear me, do it neatly.
I step back, then hold.
Our shadows overlap on the grass.

lines.zh: 你走哪都带着把剪刀吧
lines.en: You carry shears everywhere, do you not?

lines.zh: 我叫得整片草地都听见
lines.en: My bleat carries across the whole field.
My wool is pulled into a mess.

lines.zh: 我身上厚厚的毛也挡不住
lines.en: Even my thick fleece cannot stop that.
That landed on my flank.
My legs feel soft.
I shake out my whole fleece.
I press against a flockmate.

lines.zh: 我低着头一声不吭地忍
lines.en: I lower my head and endure in silence.
There is a new tear in my patches.
My four legs can still hold me.
I smell fresh grass.
I do not eat that sort of thing.
Grass in your hand, and I will come.
I drift over.
Do not pull at my fleece.
Let me lean in and sniff first.
Not enough for one bite.
Just set it down on the ground.
I chew with the taste of grass all through my mouth.
This grass beats this field's.
Do not touch me while I eat.
I look up for another serving.
Why pull your hand back?
I took it, do not chase.
I chew this mouthful very slowly.
I am done, thank you.
You bumped into my wool.

lines.zh: 我身上的补丁晃了一下
lines.en: A patch shifts on my side.
I am thick, that did not hurt.
You stepped on my hoof.
We brush apart with rumpled wool.
Don't grab my wool with your hand.
I shift one step to the side.
My wool brushed you.

lines.zh: 你手里要是剪刀就别靠近
lines.en: If that is shears, stay back.
I'm this thick — you can't hurt me with a bump.
Two sheep, one meadow.
Her patches are neater than mine.
We lean together for warmth.
This meadow feeds us both.
I watch the windward side for her.
Our two bleats blend into one.

lines.zh: 她的毛和我的缠在一起
lines.en: Her wool tangles with mine.
We walk on together, slowly.
There will be lambs come spring.
I follow along behind her.
I pick up what falls.
I hold it in my mouth and chew.
This is a bit hard.
I chew, and do not swallow.
Whose is this? I will keep it for now.
It rolled into my wool.
I shake, but it stays.
I lower my head and nudge it out.
This is worth nothing.
I set it down by my hoof.
You are on my pasture.
I lower my head — don't come closer.
I block the gap in the fence.
Take one more step and I butt you.
I have lowered my head.
There is only us here.
I do not like being crowded.
My horns have not seen much use.
Step back and I stay put.
I am ready to charge.
I keep watching you.
I turn my side square to you.
You stay, I stay.
My hoof scrapes the ground.
I count your steps.

lines.zh: 你别想从篱笆那边过去
lines.en: You will not get past the fence.
Head down, braced.
I have packed the grass under me.

lines.zh: 我等着你先迈出那一步
lines.en: I wait for you to take that first step.
Last chance.
I lower my head and charge.
My head hits your chest.
The impact rattles my patches.
That had all my weight.
You stagger back.
I nip the hem of your coat.
After one butt, I back into the grass.
There is dirt all through my wool.
Do not crowd me here again.
I am still panting hard.
I come in from beyond the fence.
A pile of wool joins the meadow.

lines.zh: 我的补丁在阳光下很显眼
lines.en: My patches stand out in the sun.
I walk slowly to the middle of the clearing.
The grass here grows thick enough.
I came over the dry grass.
I shake the dirt off my hooves.
I have not been in this patch before.
I stand and scan the surroundings.
Does anyone here shear?
My wool scorches at once.
I tumble down the bank.
Water soaks into my fleece.
The blast rolls me over.
An arrow buries in my wool.
Magic makes my fleece stand on end.
Not a blade left in this field.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我的毛都炸开
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and my wool puffs up.
The grass is gone from under me.
